The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: sad because you are alone.

draft.emotion: a soft, quiet sadness that feels heavy and hollow
notes: 'Cô đơn' describes the sad feeling of being lonely, unlike 'một mình' (alone, by oneself), which simply states the fact of being without others.

senses.definition: Unhappy because one has no friends or company.

examples.text: Tôi cảm thấy rất cô đơn khi mới chuyển đến thành phố này.
examples.translation: I felt very lonely when I first moved to this city.

draftBefore.emotion: a soft, quiet sadness that feels heavy and hollow
notes: Use 'cô đơn' to describe the feeling of being lonely. It is an emotional state, different from being simply alone (một mình), which can sometimes be a peaceful choice.

senses.definition: Feeling sad because you are alone or feel that you have no friends.

examples.text: Tôi cảm thấy rất cô đơn khi sống ở thành phố lớn này.
examples.translation: I feel very lonely living in this big city.
examples.emotion: wistful and slightly melancholy, looking out a window

senses.definition: Being without other people or things around; solitary.

examples.text: Một ngôi nhà cô đơn nằm giữa cánh đồng.
examples.translation: A solitary house stands in the middle of the field.
examples.emotion: peaceful and observant, noting a distant object

faults.quote: Being without other people or things around; solitary.
faults.why: Poetic metaphor; 'cô đơn' means lonely (emotional). Solitary/lone for objects is 'đơn độc' or 'lẻ loi'.
